kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_1: Place a Depot on the Fluid Infusion Core ...
kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_2: ... Then four buckets of liquid along the diagonals
kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_3: These fluids can be at most four diagonals away from the core ...
kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_4: ... But not allowed to be blocked
kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_5: Place the item to be processed onto the Depot ...
kubejs.ponder.fluid_infusion_core.text_6: ... Then the process is started if liquids match the recipe's requirements
kubejs.ponder.using_fluid_columns.text_2: ... We can also use fluid columns
kubejs.ponder.using_fluid_columns.text_3: The fluids at the top of the columns will be consumed
kubejs.ponder.using_fluid_columns.text_4: Until some of the columns is empty or items are used up
